title: READABLE HIT REACTIONS CHECK-IN
description: The patch turns a design concern into a calendar decision and calls that production maturity. Enemies now stagger, flash, and fall with timing that makes successful hits feel less like clerical work. Consecutive logins now build toward escalating rewards that reset just slowly enough to feel merciful.
consequence: The combat log finally stopped doing all the emotional labor. The calendar was promoted from reminder to game mechanic.

title: READABLE HIT REACTIONS BREATHER
description: The feature asks players to perform progress for each other before asking whether the progress is good. Enemies now stagger, flash, and fall with timing that makes successful hits feel less like clerical work. Daily chores have been shortened so players can leave before the evening becomes a second job.
consequence: The combat log finally stopped doing all the emotional labor. Engagement dipped, but so did the farewell essays.

title: GROUNDED TRAVERSAL PASS CHECK-IN
description: The release frames the feature as seasonal structure, while burying the real priority in the reward cadence. Jumping, mounting, and rolling now preserve more momentum debt so movement feels heavier and more authored. Consecutive logins now build toward escalating rewards that reset just slowly enough to feel merciful.
consequence: The character moves like they read the physics spec and took it personally. The calendar was promoted from reminder to game mechanic.
